agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario starts balanced (theta 0) but with seeded sensor noise 0.0145 and large dt 0.0194. Controller acts on noisy angle/rate once per coarse step, injecting erroneous forces (e.g., 16.3 at step 20 when theta 0.47). This excites oscillation that grows: by step 30 theta -0.03 but omega -8.1 and v 5.5, by step 33 theta -0.619 omega -11.7, by step 34 theta -0.853 violating 0.8 limit. Zeroing noise alone removes failure, confirming noise-driven destabilization at large dt, not initial condition or pushes (none).
